description: Reject a modulating-signal request when the canonical grid cannot support the fixed forward-backward padding.

expected_error.description: The grid 0:0.25:2 contains 9 samples, fewer than the 13 required to construct the fixed 12-sample reflection on each side.

oracle.description: The grid length is floor((2 - 0) * 4) + 1 = 9. MATLAB-compatible padlen 12 requires a signal length strictly greater than 12.
